basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Senior Project Assistant II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Kalpana Chawla Space Technology Cell at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur is hiring one Sr. Project Assistant-II (Adm & Accts) for the ISRO-IIT Kharagpur Space Technology Cell project (Project Code R/STC_2792_ZBSA), funded by the Indian Space Research Organisation. The assignment is temporary, for 36 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier, with consolidated compensation up to Rs. 25,500 per month. A Bachelors degree and 3 years of administrative experience are required. Applications are online and close on 20 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Apply online for the assignment against Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/STC_2792_ZBSA/2026/104 on or before 20 November 2026.
The application fee is Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

The notice gives a bank account for fee deposit through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking etc.: State Bank of India (00202), P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302; account name IIT SRIC-OM Account; account no. 39502115210; IFSC SBIN0000202; SWIFT SBININBB339.
The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application start date or the selection process in detail.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy
ISRO-IIT KHARAGPUR SPACE TECHNOLOGY CELL (Project Code – R/STC_2792_ZBSA)
36 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Consolidated compensation up to Rs. 25,500 per month (depending on qualification and experience)
Kalpana Chawla Space Technology Cell, IIT Kharagpur

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice also lists strong knowledge of computer systems and applications and office automation, and excellent communication and drafting skills. Relevant experience in maintaining electronic record system, equipment maintenance, tender process, and organizing meeting/workshop/conference.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelors degree with knowledge of computer office applications like MS Word, MS Excel etc., excellent communication and drafting skills, and 3 years of experience of administrative work.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 25,500 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The notice names no allowances. The tenure is 36 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier, and the assignment is described as temporary.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and that mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. It gives no interview date or other selection details.
